data.content_ref: inline:Target asserts an 'evidentiary loop' between SRC_006 and SRC_008, but the audit problem asks whether §11.3 adjudication-ritual flags are sustained. The claim that 'the ritual cannot distinguish' circular support from corroboration is unsubstantiated by any quoted procedure or evidence. No commitments were declared by the target, and no premise was provided, so the claim rests entirely on an unproven characterization of the ritual and the verdicts. Without evidence that SRC_006 and SRC_008 actually cross-reference each other—or that §11.3 lacks any mechanism to detect such loops—the assertion is unsupported.
